from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbackground = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    marker = nonbackground.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker]
    anchors = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in objects); r1 = max(r for r, c in objects)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in objects); c1 = max(c for r, c in objects)
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    cr, cc = (r1 - r0) // 2, (c1 - c0) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, ac in anchors:
        for i, row in enumerate(pattern):
            for j, value in enumerate(row):
                rr, col = ar + i - cr, ac + j - cc
                if value != background and 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                    out[rr][col] = value
    return out

source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while q:
                rr, cc = q.popleft()
                component.append((rr, cc))
                for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                        nr, nc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                        if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                                grid[nr][nc] != background and (nr, nc) not in seen):
                            seen.add((nr, nc))
                            q.append((nr, nc))
            components.append(component)
    template = max(components, key=len)
    template_set = set(template)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in template)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in template)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in template)
    center = ((r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2)
    targets = [cell for component in components if not any(p in template_set for p in component)
               for cell in component]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, ac in targets:
        dr, dc = ar - center[0], ac - center[1]
        for r, c in template:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
